confusion_notes.pst: This is the initial PST course. If you need to renew an existing certificate, see Updating PST (UPST).
confusion_notes.upst: This is the refresher/updating course. For the initial certificate, see Personal Survival Techniques (PST).
confusion_notes.pscrb: This is the full (unrestricted) PSCRB. For the yacht-specific variant, see Yacht-Restricted PSCRB (PSCRB-R).
confusion_notes.pscrb-r: This is the yacht-restricted variant. For the full version, see Proficiency in Survival Craft and Rescue Boats (PSCRB).
confusion_notes.helm-o: HELM Operational is for officer of the watch level. For chief officer / master level, see HELM Management (HELM-M).
confusion_notes.helm-m: HELM Management is for chief officer / master level. For officer of the watch level, see HELM Operational (HELM-O).
confusion_notes.basic-igf: Basic IGF Training is the entry-level qualification. For the senior officer qualification, see Advanced IGF Training.
confusion_notes.advanced-igf: Advanced IGF Training is the senior officer qualification. For the entry-level course, see Basic IGF Training.
